title: Edit the proposal
subtitle: The change is saved on behalf of the team and appears in the proposal's history. Its status and contact stay the same.
saved: Proposal updated. The change appears in the history.
leaveConfirm: Some changes are not saved. Leave the page anyway?
leadNote: The lead organisation of a submitted proposal does not change.

issues.title: The proposal cannot be saved as it is

blocked.title: This proposal cannot be edited from the back office
blocked.draft: It is still a draft: its organisation is writing it.
blocked.file_closed: It was rejected, withdrawn or cancelled.
blocked.no_call: It belongs to no call for proposals, so its input rules are unknown.
